'''Sword Squadron''' was a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] that served with the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]]. It participated in the [[Battle of Kelrodo-Ai]] as part of the [[77th Air Wing]], where it consisted of three flights: [[Blade Flight]], [[Dagger Flight]], and [[Scimitar Flight]], and at the time was composed of [[Alpha-3 Nimbus-class V-wing starfighter/Legends|Alpha-3 ''Nimbus''-class V-wing starfighters]]. By the time of the Galactic Civil War, the unit was equipped with [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighters]].
